# Office Procedure
Staff who aren't on an assignment are expected to be productive. Company work terminals are installed at most sites, and the earnings from each go straight to the site budget. Rotate between them: repeating the same task brings diminishing returns, and auditors notice.
## Records and Audit Reconcile the ledger against its receipts and flag any entry that doesn't match. Each irregularity you catch saves the Company money. Do not ask where the irregularities come from.
## Logistics Plan freight manifests for outbound shuttles to get the most value out of each load without breaching weight, volume or hazard limits. Overloaded manifests are rejected by the shuttle crew.
## Secure Transmissions Recover cipher keys from intercepted transmissions. The terminal reports how close each attempt was. Commercial, military and black-site traffic are all of interest. Black-site traffic pays best and is discussed least.
## Corporate Markets Trade commodity futures on the Company's account. - Prices update every minute. - The newswire reports on market conditions before the market reacts. Read it before every trade. - Brokerage charges 2% on every purchase and every sale. - Holdings pay a dividend of 0.5% of their value every minute. Patient positions are rewarded. - The site may hold no more than $5000 in futures at any time. - Positions are not carried over when the site's books close.
## Research Research is the Company's main source of value at any colony. It depends on the colony's research licence. Protect the licence, and the researchers.
## Reporting Significant events go up the chain of command in writing. Report losses promptly and successes immediately.
